arguments.value: Timothy K. Lewis, born in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania in 1954, served as a federal judge on the U.S. District Court for the Western District of Pennsylvania and later on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit. A graduate of Tufts University and Duquesne University School of Law, he began his legal career as an assistant district attorney in Allegheny County from 1980 to 1983 before serving as an assistant U.S. attorney for the Western District of Pennsylvania from 1983 to 1991. Nominated to the federal bench by President George H.W. Bush, Lewis was confirmed in 1991 to the district court and in 1992 to the Third Circuit, where he served until resigning in 1999.
